messages:
Ash: Hey folks — there's a pop-up dumpling workshop this Sat at 10am. Small class, $20, BYO containers. 3 spots left, anyone wanna join?
Riley: OMG yes please. Do we need to sign up now?
Ash: I can grab the spots. Quick question — who needs a ride?
Nora: I’m in. I can bring a folding table and extra napkins.
Samir: I’ll drive — 2 seats free from Dogpatch. Pickup at 9:20?
Kai: Sat is tricky for me (family thing) but I might do the indie film screening Sunday night. Anyone else interested?
Riley: Film+record fair on Sunday sounds perfect. There's a tiny record fair near the ferry with local labels.
Ash: Nice. So tentative: dumplings Sat, record fair Sun. Quick poll — who’s up for both? react with :raised_hands: or just say it.
Samir: Both. Also happy to ferry people to/from the workshop.
Nora: Both for me. Can we meet 9:45 at Bean & Ledger (16th & Maple) instead of 9:20?
Ash: 9:45 works. I'll update the reservation.
Event-bot: Event created: "Dumpling Workshop" — Sat 10:00. Invited: Ash, Riley, Nora, Samir. Details: https://events.local/dumpling-workshop
Riley: I'll bring cash + spare Tupperware :tupperware:
Nora: Heads up — they have a small vegan dumpling option if anyone needs it.
Ash: Sweet. See y'all Saturday morning. If plans shift I'll ping the thread.
Kai: If schedules free up, tag me — I might swing by the record fair Sunday evening.
